messages.スキルを捨ててバリアを張りながら、挑発値で攻撃を引き受けつつ打撃で殴る、タンク兼: A tank and Blunt attacker who Discards skills for Shield, draws attacks with Aggro, and hits back with Blunt skills. Sinking is secondary.
messages.捨ててバリア: S1「知識消耗」・S2「締め閉じる」は使用時にランクが最も高いス: **Discard for Shield**: S1 Expend Knowledge and S2 Seal Shut each Discard 1 of his highest-ranked skills on use. His defense skill, Fixated Study, Discards 2 random skills in ascending rank order. A Discarded skill grants Shield equal to Insight × a percentage of his Max HP; Discarding S3 Grace of Knowledge gives the largest percentage, 9%/12%. Insight becomes the rank of the last skill Discarded. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.挑発: S2(挑発値3)・S3(挑発値8/10)・守備(挑発値3/5)は、次のタ: **Aggro**: S2, S3, and defense give their slot Aggro next turn: 3 from S2, 8/10 from S3, and 3/5 from defense.
messages.打撃の主力: S2は3コイン、S3は4コインの打撃スキル。S3は捨てる効果を持た: **Main Blunt attacks**: S2 has 3 Coins and S3 has 4. S3 does not Discard, so using it does not grant Shield. S3 gains +1 Coin Power below 50% HP.
messages.バトルパッシブ「沈む知識」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 被ダメージ時、攻: **Combat passive — Sinking Knowledge (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When taking damage, inflicts 1 Sinking on the attacker. While he has Shield, inflicts 1 additional Sinking, up to 4 times.
messages.S1・S2を使って高ランクのスキルを捨て、バリアを得ながら次のスキルを引き寄せる: Use S1 and S2 to Discard high-ranked skills, gain Shield, and draw further into his skill pool. Faster cycling also lets him use his stronger S2 and S3 more often. Draw attacks with the Aggro from S2, S3, or defense, absorb them with Shield, and deal Blunt damage in return. Sinking Knowledge adds a little Sinking each time he is hit, but treat it as a bonus. Losing a Clash against an enemy with little Sinking can instead restore that enemy's SP; there is no need to give up Clash Wins just to trigger the passive.
